coverage_notes.scope: Bounded supplementary recall for US states, DC and territories: hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care interruptions, emergency or rural care loss, ambulance/air medical/base shutdown, CMS provider/CLIA notices, and already-effective essential-service restorations.

coverage_notes.source_review: Twelve targeted searches returned no newly substantiated, nonduplicate US/territory changes. Recent Vista Medical Center East trauma revocation/anesthesia interruption and Oct 9 dialysis interruption were already captured; October CMS entries are unchanged. Results mainly reflected historical closures, foreign incidents, policy commentary, or unfunded/proposed re-openings rather than effective restorations.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Excluded duplicates, historical cases without a new access consequence, speculative financing or business-only changes, uncompleted reopening plans, opinion, and out-of-scope international reports.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search-index latency and Sunday local-reporting gaps may conceal events; no material CMS/site access or search failure observed. Bounded recall is not comprehensive national collection.
coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approval, publication, production mutation, scheduling change, or task disablement.
